end.line: Quillon for Kingsley Ward’s coverage team

vo: Kingsley Ward handles about three hundred and fifty coverage disputes a year, comparing policy wordings by hand.
Ask whether a loss is covered, and the answer comes back cited to the page of each wording.
For a disputed claim, Quillon builds the chronology from the exhibits, and every event links to its source.
When a claims manager emails for a coverage position, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to the clause.
Samuel will walk your team through it on Tuesday the seventeenth.
